Renting a Car & Driving in South Korea: Permits, Tolls & Parking

When renting a car makes sense in South Korea, International Driving Permits, highway tolls, and city parking zones.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

On this page

  1. Key takeaways for first-time visitors
  2. Step-by-step practical advice
  3. Common mistakes to avoid

When renting a car makes sense in South Korea, International Driving Permits, highway tolls, and city parking zones.

Key takeaways for first-time visitors

  • Official transport: KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail connects Seoul, Busan, and Jeju Island with frequent daily departures.
  • Payments: Contactless Visa/Mastercard and mobile wallets are widely accepted across South Korea, alongside small cash in KRW (₩) for rural buses and bakeries.
  • Power & connectivity: South Korea uses Types C & F (220V / 60Hz). Install an eSIM before departure so rail apps and maps work as soon as you land.

Step-by-step practical advice

When planning your route through South Korea, anchor your itinerary around 2 or 3 main bases (Seoul, Busan, and Jeju Island) and use regional trains for scenic day trips into our complete directory of every municipality in South Korea.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Overpacking your schedule with one-night hotel hops instead of using KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail for day trips.
  • Waiting until the day of travel to book peak-season high-speed trains or timed-entry museum tickets.
  • Accepting Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) on card terminals — always choose to be charged in local currency (KRW).

Frequently asked questions

What is the most important tip for renting a car & driving in south korea: permits, tolls & parking?

Book flagship KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail trains and major museum timed-entry tickets ahead of time, and keep both a contactless card and a small reserve of KRW (₩) cash.

Where can I verify official rules for South Korea?

Check the official national tourism portal (https://english.visitkorea.or.kr/) and national rail operator (https://www.letskorail.com/ebizbf/EbizBfIndex_eng.do) before departure.

Official sources & further reading

Rules, prices and schedules change. Confirm details here before you travel:
